items.title: PayPal names HP CEO Enrique Lores as new chief
items.description:
PayPal appointed HP Inc. chief executive Enrique Lores as its new president and CEO effective March 1, while shares tumbled after the company reported fourth-quarter results that missed estimates and issued a subdued 2026 profit forecast on Tuesday.

The digital payments company posted adjusted earnings of $1.23 per share for the holiday quarter, falling short of the $1.29 analysts expected, according to data from Investing.com. Revenue came in at $8.68 billion, below the $8.79 billion consensus estimate. Shares dropped more than 16% in premarket trading following the release.[1][2][3][4][5]

items.title: European stocks hit record high as metals stabilize

featured_image.name: European shares hit record highs, focus shifts to earnings

items.description:
The STOXX Europe 600 reached an all-time high on Tuesday, rising 0.8% to 622.46 points in morning trading, as a turbulent selloff in precious metals appeared to ease and investors turned their attention to corporate earnings.[1][2]

The record performance came after a volatile stretch for global markets. Gold and silver suffered their steepest declines in decades last Friday following President Donald Trump's nomination of Kevin Warsh, a policy hawk, as the next chair of the U.S. Federal Reserve. Silver plunged approximately 30% on Friday, its worst single-day drop since 1980, while gold fell about 9%. The CME Group subsequently raised margin requirements on Comex gold and silver futures, increasing gold margins to 8% from 6% and silver margins to 15% from 11%.[3][4][5][6][7]

items.title: Asian markets rally on RBA rate hike, US-India trade deal

featured_image.name: Asia-Pacific markets: Nikkei 225, Kospi, Hang Seng Index, Iran, Powell

items.description:
Asian equity markets surged on Tuesday as investors digested a pair of developments that brightened the economic outlook: the Reserve Bank of Australia's first interest rate hike in two years and a newly announced trade agreement between the United States and India.

Japan's Nikkei 225 climbed over 3% to reach record highs, while South Korea's Kospi rocketed 5%, triggering a buy sidecar after the index's futures rose more than 5% for over a minute. India's Nifty 50 jumped roughly 3%, approaching its all-time high, as traders responded enthusiastically to the tariff relief from Washington. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 added 1.3%, buoyed by the central bank's decisive move to combat inflation.[1][2][3]

items.title: Gold, silver rebound after historic crash on Fed chair pick

featured_image.name: Gold prices fall as Trump announces Kevin Warsh as Fed chair pick

items.description:
Gold and silver staged a recovery in Tuesday's Asian trading session after enduring one of the most violent selloffs in modern market history, a crash triggered by President Donald Trump's nomination of Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve chair and amplified by cascading margin calls.

Spot gold climbed more than 3% to around $4,837 per ounce on Tuesday morning, rebounding from Monday's lows near $4,400. Silver jumped more than 5% to approximately $84 per ounce after testing lows below $72 earlier in the week. The recovery came as calmer conditions returned to markets that had been roiled by forced liquidations and extreme volatility.[1][2][3][4]

items.title: Musk confirms SpaceX-xAI merger ahead of planned IPO

featured_image.name: Musk Is Said to Be in Advanced Talks to Combine SpaceX, xAI

items.description:
Elon Musk is combining his rocket and satellite company SpaceX with his artificial intelligence firm xAI in a corporate consolidation that could set the stage for one of the largest initial public offerings in history. The deal was announced via internal memo on Monday, according to Bloomberg News, bringing together Musk's space exploration infrastructure with his AI ambitions under a single corporate umbrella.[1][2][3]

The newly combined entity is expected to be valued at approximately $1.25 trillion, with a share price set around $527, according to Reuters citing Bloomberg's reporting. The merger comes as SpaceX prepares for a mid-June IPO that could raise as much as $50 billion and value the company at roughly $1.5 trillion, according to the Financial Times.[4][5][6][7][1]

items.title: Wall Street rises as oil, gold slide on US-Iran diplomatic thaw

featured_image.name: Dow surges 500 points as traders look past rout in precious metals and bitcoin: Live updates

items.description:
Wall Street rebounded Monday as diplomatic progress between the United States and Iran unwound the geopolitical risk premiums that had driven commodity prices higher in recent weeks. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose more than 500 points while crude oil tumbled more than 4% and precious metals extended a historic rout.

The rally came after President Donald Trump said over the weekend that Iran was "seriously talking" with Washington, and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian ordered the resumption of nuclear negotiations. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is expected to meet White House envoy Steve Witkoff on Friday in Istanbul for the first direct engagement between U.S. and Iranian officials since the collapse of talks and the 12-day conflict in June 2025.[1][2][3]

items.title: German researchers develop AI drones to locate radioactive waste in minutes

featured_image.name: German military drones, robots hunt radioactive waste in ...

items.description:
Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Communication, Information Processing and Ergonomics FKIE in Germany have developed AI-powered drones and robots capable of locating radioactive sources within a few meters in just minutes, addressing one of the most dangerous challenges facing emergency responders.[1][2][3][4]

The technology, unveiled this week, aims to protect first responders and civilians from the invisible threat posed by chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive substances (CBRNE) that cannot be detected by humans from a safe distance.[2][5]

items.title: NASA pauses Artemis II fueling test after hydrogen leak detected

featured_image.name: NASA fuels Artemis II moon rocket in test to clear the way for Super ...

items.description:
NASA is conducting a high-stakes fueling test of its massive moon rocket Monday as the agency pushes toward the first crewed lunar mission in more than 50 years, though engineers have encountered a hydrogen leak that required troubleshooting during the critical rehearsal.

The wet dress rehearsal, which began Saturday evening at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, simulates launch day procedures by loading the 322-foot Space Launch System rocket with more than 700,000 gallons of super-cold liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen. If successful, the Artemis II mission could launch as early as February 8, sending four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the moon.[1][2][3]

items.title: Glencore nears Citi appointment for Rio Tinto merger talks

featured_image.name: Glencore close to appointing Citi as adviser for Rio Tinto ...

items.description:
Swiss miner Glencore is close to engaging Citigroup as its lead investment bank on its potential acquisition by Rio Tinto, a deal that could create the world's largest mining company worth over $200 billion, according to Reuters citing two people familiar with the matter.[1][2]

Citigroup Global Markets Inc. filed disclosures with the UK Takeover Panel in January, identifying itself as connected with Glencore in relation to a possible deal with Rio Tinto, according to filings made at the London Stock Exchange. Both Citi and Glencore declined to comment on the appointment.[3][2]
